_doc: 48x48 portraits of the 24 named heroes (FACTION_HUMANS, FACTION_UNDEAD and FACTION_GOBLINS section 8; NAMED_HEROES in src/data/classes.ts). Same endpoint, layers and options as the class portraits of class-heroes (bzc.14): each hero keeps the class costume and colours of its class portrait and differs as a person (face, hair, age, one accessory from the name or specialty). No faction layer (the 2000-character cap); colours in each subject. Faces south-east, never mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: Sir Cuthbert the Unhorsed portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute old knight who keeps falling off his horse: a round ruddy face, a huge bushy white walrus moustache, a white plaster cross on his bruised nose, a dented open-faced light steel helmet with a bent crimson plume, a crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow cross over light steel pauldrons.
